en: Black‑and‑white view of a quiet, early‑20th‑century European street with cobblestones and sidewalks lined by trees and substantial bourgeois townhouses or villas. Toward the background stands a prominent church with a tall spire, a clock on its tower, and cross on top. In the right foreground a small herd of horses is being led along the street, while a few pedestrians walk farther back. The scene is calm and orderly, with no automobiles visible.
